messages.subject: Re: unable to load shared object '/usr/lib64/RRO-3.2.2/R-3.2.2/lib64/R/modules//R_X11.so
parts:
Hello Freddy,

Do you have this problem when using RRO from the GUI instead of RStudio?

Also, are you installing on a CentOS server machine? If yes, if X11 installed?  X11 is not commonly installed on a server. 

Without X11 libraries, you won’t be able to plot graphics interactively, but you can still generate the graphics with plot and create a outfile that contains the plot, like a jpeg or png graph.

 

If you don’t have the X11 libraries, consider installing them after the fact. However, if you are running on a server, you may not want to do that. 

Thank you,
Josée
